campaign_name: Remaining Baseline Triage and Root-Cause Confirmation
purpose: Convert the 36-test red baseline into evidence-backed repair, cleanup, policy, and unresolved queues without repairing behavior.
executive_summary: The baseline remains 36 failures. The investigation maps every failure exactly once into 25 root-cause clusters: 4 product-defect failures, 10 architecture-defect failures, 3 validation-defect failures, 8 stale expectations, 1 stale fixture, 4 governance-drift failures, 4 policy-decision failures, and 2 unresolved failures. The six ownership/import failures split into current production facade violations, test-helper validation defects, registry drift, and direct unstamped writes. No repair was implemented.

tooling: Added registry and queue generator plus five accounting tests.
generated_artifacts: Added investigation registry, root-cause clusters, repair queue, cleanup queue, policy queue, and JUnit baselines.

testing.broader: All 36 failures reproduced in the full pre-triage suite.
testing.full_suite: Pre: 6,440 collected, 6,305 passed, 36 failed, 99 skipped. Post: 6,445 collected, 6,310 passed, 36 failed, 99 skipped. The five added cases are passing triage-tooling tests.
testing.runtime_validation: Existing deterministic tests only; no runtime semantics changed.
testing.new_regressions: None; the exact failure set is unchanged.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Define the permitted local raw-token boundary.

pre_existing: RC-11 opening debug ordering and RC-13 long-session diagnostic divergence remain unresolved.

missing_concepts: Repair implementation, validation cleanup, Calibration Round 2, State-to-Narration Consistency, and browser validation are out of scope.
does_not_prove: That all failures are production defects.
That policy-decision or unresolved cases are safe to change.
recommended_next_step: Review the confirmed queue, then repair approved P0/P1 root causes in a separate campaign.

supporting_files.why: Accounts for all failures and clusters with evidence.
Contains only confirmed product and architecture repairs.
Checks complete accounting and queue consistency.

self_contained_review_test: PASS: report, per-test registry, queues, policy questions, and pre/post JUnit are bundled.
